articles.title: Mack Geiger、カントリーな新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Mack Geigerが2026年11月6日(金)にニューアルバム『Dying In This House』をリリースした。 本作は伝統的なカントリーミュージックの豊かなサウンドと、人生の機微をすくい取る等身大のストーリーテリングが融合した作品。失恋、孤独、後悔、家族への愛情、そして困難の先に見いだす希望まで、人間の複雑な感情を丁寧に描き出している。 アルバムの中心にあるのは、ひとりの男が孤独や失恋、否認と向き合いながら、少しずつ自分自身を取り戻していく物語。プロデュースには、ナッシュビルのベテランプロデューサー・Keith StegallとJared Adlamを迎え、作品全体に一貫した音楽的な世界観を構築している。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/441226…
articles.translatedTitle: Mack Geiger releases new country AL
articles.translatedExcerpt: Mack Geiger released his new album ``Dying In This House'' on Friday, November 6, 2026. This work combines the rich sounds of traditional country music with life-sized storytelling that captures the subtleties of life. It carefully depicts the complex human emotions of heartbreak, loneliness, regret, love for family, and even the hope found beyond hardship. At the heart of the album is the story of a man gradually regaining himself while dealing with loneliness, heartbreak, and denial. Produced by veteran Nashville producers Keith Stegall and Jared Adlam, they create a consistent musical worldview throughout the album. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/441226…

articles.translatedTitle: Kanpekina Hoshi releases new song “Watchi”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Kanpekina Hoshi, a three-person band based in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo, digitally released their new single "Watchi" on November 11th (Wednesday). Kanpekina Hoshi is a three-person band whose lyrics and compositions are written by Gt./Vo. Reimi Okabe, and whose sound is a cross between the lyricism of folk and the fluctuations of shoegaze. Through Japanese lyrics that describe everyday emotions and love, and delicate melodies and tones, they create a unique world of music. The new song "Watchi" is a song that depicts love for one's family and the pain and loneliness that arises within that relationship. The song expresses the family relationship where love and hate, happiness and unhappiness exist side by side, using bright and airy sounds. The song is a song that describes the joys, conflicts, and sometimes conflicting emotions that come from connecting with family in frank words, and depicts the feelings of beings who leave a mark on one's life, for better or for worse.

articles.translatedTitle: <GREEN×EXPO 2027> International Horticultural Exhibition Association and Yoshimoto Kogyo Holdings conclude comprehensive collaboration agreement
articles.translatedExcerpt: The 2027 International Horticultural Exposition Association and Yoshimoto Kogyo Holdings Co., Ltd. signed a comprehensive partnership agreement on Wednesday, November 11th to help realize a sustainable society and foster momentum for the expo. A ``Comprehensive Cooperation Agreement Signing Ceremony'' was held at Shibuya Yoshimoto Manzai Theater. articles.translatedTitle: Hannah Warm releases new song “JOY” depicting the euphoria of love
articles.translatedExcerpt: Singer-songwriter/designer Hannah Warm began distributing her new song "JOY" on Wednesday, November 11th. At <MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026>, Hannah Warm attracted attention when her album “VIA” was nominated for the Best Artwork Award. The newly released new song "JOY" is a crossover pop number that blends R&B with the essence of 70's soul, AOR, and modern Indie Pop. A bouncy piano leads the rhythm, and the warm tones of an analog synthesizer spread over and over again over a light beat. The sound, which combines vintage textures and modern sophistication, is a natural companion to winter cityscapes adorned with illuminations and the festive atmosphere of the Christmas season.

articles.translatedTitle: “Remi Hirano All About Charm” will be released, including 21 songs.
articles.translatedExcerpt: It has been decided that Remi Hirano will release ``Remi Hirano All About Charm'' on Wednesday, December 2nd. Remi Hirano, who was active as a chanson singer, made her record debut in 1970 with the single "Temptation of Bayon" from Nippon Columbia. By 1972, they had released a total of four singles. This time, while organizing Columbia's in-house master tapes in preparation for making CDs of the sound sources from that time, the sound sources of four unreleased songs were newly discovered. One of these songs, ``I'm Calling You,'' which was recorded in 1972, had only the song title written on the tape and the artist's name unknown, but when Hirano listened to it for the first time in about half a century, it was discovered that the lyrics were written by his father, the late French literary scholar and poet Imao Hirano. The relevant lyrics were also found in a collection of poems written by his father that had been left at home. While the flowing beauty of the formation changes permeates throughout the song, pay attention to the powerful and supple dance that does not break even in the midst of intense developments, as well as the facial expression management that perfectly expresses the worldview of the song, which is a mixture of madness and love. In addition, the costume in this video is made of shiny fabric that seems to be wrapped in surrounding light, and is made of beads of the same color.

articles.translatedTitle: YOASOBI releases new song “KILLA” from artist discovery and development project “First Time” Literary Club
articles.translatedExcerpt: YOASOBI has decided to release their new song "KILLA" on November 11th (Wednesday). This work is based on a novel born out of the ``Hajimete'' Literary Club, a program launched in 2022 as part of the ``Hajimete'' collaboration project with four Naoki Prize-winning authors, with the aim of discovering and nurturing new writers who will lead the next generation of literary circles. At the same time, the song jacket has also been released. The original novel is ``I Want to Kill Senpai, so I Dress as a Woman'' by Yoa Maeneko, who was a member of the first generation of ``The First Literary Club''. This work, which was released as a book on October 16th (Friday), is Maneko Yoa's debut work. In order to fulfill the wishes of the person he loves, a boy becomes the "ideal beautiful girl." A dangerous yet funny story that depicts the distortions and purity of love through the image of a boy who changes himself for the sake of the person he falls in love with.

articles.translatedTitle: Keisuke Kuwata's new song "Kamigami no Sash" will be released. Ukiyo-e motif artwork released
articles.translatedExcerpt: Keisuke Kuwata has announced that his new song ``Kamigami no Sash'' will be released on November 16, 2026. At the same time, the jacket photo of the song with an ukiyo-e motif was also released, and a Pre-add/Pre-save campaign has started where you can receive a special wallpaper. "Tasuki of the Gods" is a song written specifically for the drama "Oretachi no Hakone Ekiden," which was the theme song. Set against the backdrop of the Hakone Ekiden stage, the anthem is an ensemble drama that weaves together a group of people from all walks of life, from the runners to those supporting, watching, and cheering on the challenge, all tied together through the ``sash'' of music. It begins with an intro reminiscent of the tense heartbeat before running, and as the story moves forward, the sound becomes more dynamic, and eventually expands like a refreshing, sparkling wind blowing through. The scenes surrounding Hakone Road are incorporated throughout, but the victory and defeat alone speak for themselves...

articles.translatedTitle: nomi., new AL release containing 11 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: nomi. released their new album ``This Wolf May Cry'' on Friday, October 30, 2026. She has attracted attention from SZA, Tyler, The Creator, Pharrell Williams, Kaytranada, and more. This is a full-length album that brings to fruition the musical identity that has been presented little by little through singles and EPs. Although it has a compact composition of 11 songs, approximately 30 minutes, it traverses modern R&B, neo-soul, alternative pop, and even a rhythm reminiscent of UK garage. With a soft, floating singing voice and a production with a unique blank space, it is a work that invites the listener to a slightly mysterious world of music. articles.translatedExcerpt: Crab Crab Club released their new song "Homing" today, November 4, 2026 (Wednesday). This work is a sci-fi rock number that depicts the feelings of two people separated by several light years, with the theme of feelings for "you" that never disappear no matter how far apart they are. This is a song that embodies Crab Club's unique worldview, which combines sci-fi ideas with everyday emotions, layering the loneliness and love that everyone knows on a grand space story. In terms of sound, it's guitar rock centered around lightly moving guitar phrases and the dynamic groove of the bass and drums. The bright sound with a sense of speed is layered with the echo of the heartrending lyrics. The jacket consists of an illustration by illustrator "Pin Ponpo." and the title logo of Crab Kani Club's Dr. Ryuto. A music video produced by the two will also be released at a later date.

articles.translatedTitle: shosha releases introspective new song “Anchor”
articles.translatedExcerpt: shosha released a new single "Anchor" on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. This is his fourth work since the beginning of this year, and it is a song that introspectively depicts the process of being in the midst of love and heading towards its end. The song's lyrics are based on the contradictions and conflicts between the desire to hold back the person who is leaving and the resignation that is accepting the ending, and the title ``Anchor'' is a metaphor for trying to hold on to the heart of someone who is leaving. The sound is a pop-oriented liquid drum and bass. Layering whispering vocal samples, gentle felt piano chords, and a low, crawling Reese bass, they create a quiet yet propulsive beat. Additionally, the album will be released on November 25th (Wednesday). It is scheduled to include a total of 8 songs, including previously released songs that have been released since September.
